Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4); roll-forward is fund balances 245,413 -> 275,129 (p4). Transfers 75 General in / 75 Fire Department out (fund columns p4; Total column nets to 0). Ending cash = Cash 208,308, CDs 84,511 as investments (p3); Funds Held by County Treasurer 1,101 separate; no prior-year governmental cash printed (the p8 all-funds 'Beginning Cash' 498,582 mixes all funds). Business-type: single proprietary (utility) fund, statement of revenues, expenses and changes in net assets (p6, modified cash), measure net position; zero-amount rows (ARPA Expenditures, Bond and Insurance) omitted; cash flow statement p7 is modified cash basis, so proprietary left null (as later years). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1); interfund receivable/payable 17,280 eliminated (*) in the Total column, recorded as eliminations lines.
